avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces oxycodone levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; discuss alternative antidepressants with prescriber

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and respiratory depression risk

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression, sedation, and respiratory depression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; use alternative for sleep support only under medical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit supplement
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase oxycodone levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased oxycodone effects; limit concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Black Cohosh
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased drowsiness or dizziness

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases oxycodone bioavailability and toxicity risk

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase oxycodone absorption and peak levels
caution_foods.action: Take oxycodone consistently with or without food; avoid variable fat intake patterns

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and increased respiratory depression risk
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid alcohol; educate on serious overdose risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of overdose (respiratory depression, altered consciousness, pinpoint pupils) especially with CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitors or CNS depressants. Counsel patients on addiction risk, fall prevention, and constipation management.
